leads.title: Apple to Curb AI Agents' Full-Disk Access on Macs
leads.thesis: Apple will restrict full-disk access on macOS because AI agents have 'substantially' increased abuse risk, a shift that will change how autonomous assistants operate on Macs.

leads.title: DeepMind Unveils Gemini 4 Argon as Next Frontier Era
leads.thesis: DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon as its next era of frontier intelligence, positioning it as a step-change in reasoning and multimodal capability.

leads.title: White House Issues 'Superintelligence' Executive Order With Industry Accord
leads.thesis: The White House unveiled an executive order on superintelligence alongside a voluntary industry accord, attempting to set federal guardrails for frontier AI development.

leads.title: China-Linked Hackers Impersonated US Officials to Target AI Experts
leads.thesis: China-linked hackers posed as former US officials and an Anthropic employee to target AI experts, according to a Defense One report on a spear-phishing campaign.

leads.title: Memory Makers Warn RAM Shortage Will Last Through 2028
leads.thesis: Memory executives including Micron's CEO expect the RAM shortage to continue through 2028 as AI data-center demand tightens supply.

leads.title: Two US Federal Agency Hacks Spill Sensitive Data in a Month
leads.thesis: Hacks of two federal agencies within a month spilled a bonanza of sensitive data, Ars Technica reports, raising questions about federal cybersecurity posture.

leads.title: Flaw in ChatGPT Mac App Could Have Exposed Sensitive Data
leads.thesis: A flaw in OpenAI's ChatGPT Mac app could have let hackers grab sensitive user data, Wired reports, before a fix was issued.

leads.title: Meta Open-Sources Code for Muse AI Gadgets
leads.thesis: Meta open-sourced code to let developers build Muse-infused gadgets, pushing its AI assistant into DIY hardware.

leads.title: Trillium Labs Pushes High-Risk AI Research in the Open
leads.thesis: A group of AI experts behind Trillium Labs wants to conduct high-stakes AI research openly rather than behind closed lab doors, Wired reports.

leads.title: Sean Parker Rebuilds Stability AI Around Music
leads.thesis: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI with a focus on music generation, TechCrunch reports, after the company's turbulent leadership changes.

leads.title: OpenAI Publishes Practical Guide for Building With GPT-6
leads.thesis: OpenAI published a practical guide for building with its GPT-6 family, detailing how developers should use the new models.

leads.title: DeepMind Introduces SynthID Bio Watermarking
leads.thesis: DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, a watermarking system for AI-generated biological sequences and data.

leads.title: Africa Demands Seat at Table on AI Safety Governance
leads.thesis: African leaders are pressing for a voice in global AI safety decisions, including at the UN Security Council, Rest of World reports.

leads.title: Ethiopian Forces Retake Mekelle Airport From Tigray Rebels
leads.thesis: Ethiopia's government forces retook the airport in Mekelle as they advanced against Tigray rebels, Al Jazeera reports, marking a potential turning point in the renewed conflict.

leads.title: China Launches Anti-Dumping Probe Into EU Chemical Imports
leads.thesis: China launched an anti-dumping investigation into EU p-nitrotoluene imports ahead of scheduled trade talks, The Hindu reports.

leads.title: Chinese Troops Join Russia's Tsentr-2026 Exercise
leads.thesis: Chinese troops lined up for Russia's Tsentr-2026 military exercise as bilateral military ties tighten, SCMP reports.

leads.title: Vietnam's Economy Grew 9.95% in Q3, Fastest in Four Years
leads.thesis: Vietnam's economy grew 9.95% in the third quarter, its fastest pace in four years, Nikkei Asia reports, on strong exports and manufacturing.

leads.title: Morocco Appoints First Female Head of Government
leads.thesis: Morocco appointed its first female head of government, prompting debate over whether the move is symbolic or substantive reform, DW reports.

leads.title: Argentina to Sell Citizenship for $350,000
leads.thesis: Argentina plans to sell citizenship to foreigners for $350,000 to raise dollars, Mercopress reports, joining a small club of citizenship-by-investment programs.

leads.title: Taiwan Foreign Minister to Visit Arizona to Deepen Economic Ties
leads.thesis: Taiwan's foreign minister will visit Arizona to deepen economic ties, likely linked to TSMC's semiconductor investments, Japan Times reports.

leads.title: 43 Killed in Political Hits Ahead of South Africa Polls
leads.thesis: A report found 43 people were killed in political assassinations ahead of South Africa's elections, Africanews reports.

leads.title: Israeli Airstrike on Gaza City Apartment Kills Five
leads.thesis: At least five civilians were killed in an Israeli airstrike on a residential apartment in Gaza City, Al Jazeera reports.

leads.title: Gunmen Kill Three in Damascus Countryside Village
leads.thesis: Unknown gunmen killed three and injured seven in Ras al-Maara in the Damascus countryside, Hawar News reports.

leads.title: 'Super El Niño' Breaks All-Time Record
leads.thesis: Analysis shows the recent 'super El Niño' reached a remarkable all-time record, Carbon Brief reports, with implications for global heat and extremes.

leads.title: California Legalizes Balcony Solar Power Plants
leads.thesis: California made it legal to turn balconies into tiny power plants with plug-in solar, Grist reports, easing rules for apartment dwellers.

leads.title: Cooper Pairs Found Above Superconducting Critical Temperature
leads.thesis: Physicists found Cooper pairs persisting above the superconducting critical temperature in a pairing regime, Phys.org reports, challenging textbook boundaries.

leads.title: Sea Monkeys Rewrite a Rule of Turbulence
leads.thesis: Experiments with brine shrimp (sea monkeys) show how collective swimming can rewrite a rule of turbulence, Quanta Magazine reports.

leads.title: Ancient Pottery Reveals Earliest Chocolate East of the Rockies
leads.thesis: Ancient pottery analysis revealed the earliest known traces of chocolate east of the Rockies in the Americas, Smithsonian reports.

leads.title: ESA Spots Galaxy Spinning Out of Sync
leads.thesis: ESA highlighted a galaxy spinning out of sync, with misaligned rotation suggesting a past merger or gas accretion.

leads.title: Giant Stick Insect Fooled Scientists for Decades
leads.thesis: A giant stick insect long thought to be one species was revealed to be distinct after decades of confusion, SciDaily reports.

leads.title: Yosemite Toads Survive Winter Only to Succumb to Fungus
leads.thesis: Young Yosemite toads survive winter hibernation then emerge with deadly chytrid fungus infections, Science News reports.

leads.title: Mathematicians and AI Battle Over What Counts as True
leads.thesis: Mathematicians and AI systems are in a behind-the-scenes battle over what counts as true proof, New Scientist reports.

leads.title: Toyota Opens $50M Battery Center in Michigan
leads.thesis: Toyota opened a $50 million battery center in Michigan targeting EVs, hybrids and longer-lasting batteries, Interesting Engineering reports.

leads.title: NIH Rolls Out Streamlined Public Website
leads.thesis: NIH is rolling out a streamlined website to help the public find health information more easily, STAT reports.

leads.title: California Coastal Wave to Raise Sea Levels Statewide
leads.thesis: A coastal wave surging up the US West Coast is set to raise sea levels in California, Phys.org reports, amplifying flood risk.

leads.title: AI Emulation of Sudden Stratospheric Warming Shows Promise
leads.thesis: A new paper presents AI emulation of stochastic sudden stratospheric warming with interpretable dynamics, offering faster polar vortex forecasts.

leads.title: KaliBench Tests AI Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux
leads.thesis: Researchers released KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark for cybersecurity tool use on Kali Linux, to test AI agents' hacking skills.

leads.title: From DNA Design to Slimming: Auditable Agentic Discovery
leads.thesis: A paper demonstrates auditable agentic discovery from DNA design to DNA slimming, showing AI agents that design and minimize genetic constructs.

leads.title: Learning SYK Hamiltonians With Machine Learning
leads.thesis: A physics preprint on learning SYK Hamiltonians explores how machine learning can reconstruct Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models from data.

leads.title: Trace-Anomaly Dark Matter Scaling in Compact Objects
leads.thesis: A preprint proposes trace-anomaly decomposition and universal dark matter scaling in compact objects like neutron stars.
